scope: Wikidata structured item metadata: validated Q identifier, English label and description from wbsearchentities.

rights.retrieval: Public Action API without a paid key, subject to Wikimedia API usage policies and upstream availability.
rights.retention: CC0 structured metadata can be retained in result snapshots; raw upstream payloads are not stored.
rights.display: CC0 item labels and descriptions may be displayed.
rights.redistribution: CC0 structured metadata may be redistributed; this does not cover linked articles or other namespaces.
rights.evaluation: CC0 structured metadata may be used in evaluations; query/feedback privacy remains separate.
rights.training: CC0 does not impose a copyright restriction on reuse; MVP training is disabled and any future dataset requires a separate rights/privacy review.

attribution: Wikidata contributors plus the item identifier; preserved for provenance although CC0 does not require attribution.
runtime_requirements: Explicitly enable wikidata and request it; default operation uses only local data.
Set ANVESHA_WIKIDATA_USER_AGENT, for example AnveshaBot/0.1 (mailto:you@example.org), using the operator's real contact information.
Use one fixed HTTPS endpoint, no redirects, identity response encoding, and a maximum 1 MiB response.
Use 5-second HTTP operation timeouts and a 15-second response-body elapsed budget checked between chunks; no automatic retries inside a job.
Respect maxlag and HTTP failures; surface them as partial/failed search status.
limitations: Entity label/alias search is not general-web search or full document retrieval.
Only English-language entity metadata is requested in M1.
No linked pages, article prose, images, or other Wikimedia text namespaces are covered or fetched.
Metadata is unverified user-contributed information; metadata_only is not factual verification.
Explicit live requests disclose the query and operator's network address to Wikimedia.
HTTP timeouts bound inactivity, not a strict end-to-end wall-clock deadline; expired leases prevent late publication.
Hosted quotas, cross-worker rate limits and configurable retention are tracked under ANV-008.
